subject: massage-therapy
intro: Massage therapy leads to hands-on work in soft tissue health — the licensed therapists in clinics and spas, the acupuncturists who pair needles with bodywork, and the rehabilitation and fitness professionals who move people better.

roles.title: Massage Therapists
roles.what: Perform therapeutic massages of soft tissues and joints, assist in the assessment of range of motion and muscle strength, and propose client therapy plans for relief, recovery and relaxation.
roles.where: This is the course's destination career: the technique domains unit trains the Swedish, deep tissue and trigger-point work of the job, and the assessment and treatment planning unit is the session planning you will run with every client.

roles.title: Acupuncturists
roles.what: Diagnose, treat and prevent disorders by stimulating specific acupuncture points with needles, and may also use cups, nutritional supplements, therapeutic massage, acupressure and other alternative health therapies.
roles.where: Therapeutic massage and acupressure sit inside the specialised modalities topic, and the pathology and contraindications unit — knowing what not to treat and when to refer — governs every alternative-medicine session.

roles.title: Physical Therapists
roles.what: Assess, plan, organise and participate in rehabilitative programmes that improve mobility, relieve pain, increase strength, and correct disabling conditions resulting from disease or injury.
roles.where: The anatomy, physiology and kinesiology unit — muscles, bones, joints and movement terminology — and the postural and range-of-motion assessment topics are the shared language of rehabilitation therapy.

roles.title: Exercise Trainers and Group Fitness Instructors
roles.what: Instruct or coach groups or individuals in exercise activities for personal fitness: demonstrate techniques and form, observe participants, explain corrective measures, and develop individualised exercise approaches.
roles.where: Movement terminology and postural assessment from the kinesiology unit let you spot faulty form, while the client interview and session-planning topics map to designing individualised programmes.
